description: tests/test_verify_release.py had no __main__ guard at all, so Bazel ran zero of its 13 tests. A new tests/test_every_test_class_runs_under_bazel.py now fails if any tests/test_*.py is ever missing a trailing __main__ guard, or has one that isn't its last statement.
summary: Stop test classes below a __main__ block from being skipped under Bazel
